dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: It's great! I got to talk to Tubby for the whole day!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Her full name is even harder to remember than the "Boom and Blast Kuuvahki Energy Cannon." Something to do with rain, I think? I don't get it at all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's one of the adepti from Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh right, yeah... Another group that can't be explained in terms of science and mechanics...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: That seems to be a recurring theme ever since leaving Nod-Krai...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Well, anyway, Tubby told me building things here is super easy. All you need is a blueprint.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: So, I decided to get started on my next machine. I had the design schematic, tools, and components all ready to go, but then she said none of it was useable...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, we use adeptal arts instead...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: See? So, it's not easy at all! It's nothing like what I'm used to! I guess that means no tinkering for me...

choices.text: It's okay. Just tell me what you're thinking.

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: I'm a little sad I won't get to build anything, but as a guest here, I guess it's better not to overstep...

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: But, uh... could we maybe get a krumkake-maker?

response.speaker: Aino
response.text: Then, at least, we'll have something to snack on together!
